description:
The Connect service will be deployed under the name **connect‑service** with two worker instances, each allocated 4 CPU shares, 2 GB of memory and a 1 GB JVM heap. It belongs to the **prod‑connect‑group** and will run on nodes tagged with the **worker** role as the user **nobody**. Both the key and value converters are set to **io.confluent.connect.avro.AvroConverter** with schema validation enabled, and the service advertises the full CORS set “GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,HEAD” and allows any origin (“*”). Virtual networking is turned on, joining the **dcos** network, and the plugin receives the labels environment=production and team=data‑platform.

For Kafka connectivity the bootstrap servers are **broker‑1.kafka.l4lb.thisdcos.directory:9092** and **broker‑2.kafka.l4lb.thisdcos.directory:9092**. The client uses SASL SSL with the GSSAPI mechanism and a Kerberos service name of **kafka**, though Kerberos authentication is currently disabled (the relevant JAAS, keytab and krb5 secrets are present but unused). Zookeeper is reachable at **master.mesos:2181/dcos-service-confluent-kafka**. Finally, the Connect workers will register schemas against the Schema Registry located at **http://schema-registry.marathon.l4lb.thisdcos.directory:8081**.
